import hashlib,json,os,re,socket,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
assert os.geteuid()==0 and socket.gethostname()=='infra-serverless'
results=[]
for guard in guards:
 unit=guard['unit'];assert re.fullmatch(r'serverless-restore-duplicate-code-[0-9a-f]{32}',unit)
 folder=Path('/run')/unit;receipt=json.loads((folder/'restored.json').read_text());assert receipt==guard['restored']
 raw=subprocess.check_output(['journalctl','--no-pager','-o','json','-u',unit+'.service'],text=True,timeout=20)
 entries=[];executions=[]
 for line in raw.splitlines():
  value=json.loads(line);message=value.get('MESSAGE','');entry={k:value[k] for k in ('__REALTIME_TIMESTAMP','_PID','_SYSTEMD_UNIT','MESSAGE') if k in value};entries.append(entry)
  if isinstance(message,str) and message.startswith('{'):
   emitted=json.loads(message)
   if emitted.get('completed'):
    assert emitted==receipt and value['_SYSTEMD_UNIT']==unit+'.service' and int(value['_PID'])>0;executions.append(entry)
 if guard['kind']=='restart':assert len(executions)==1 and receipt['trigger']=='independent'
 else:assert not executions and receipt['trigger']=='explicit'
 results.append({'unit':unit,'kind':guard['kind'],'receipt_sha256':hashlib.sha256((folder/'restored.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'receipt_mtime_ns':(folder/'restored.json').stat().st_mtime_ns,'journal_entries':entries,'independent_executions':executions})
print(json.dumps({'completed':True,'guards':results}))
